semiconductor_relevance: High — Myungsung Instrument specializes in pressure and temperature sensors specifically designed for semiconductor processes, ensuring reliability in harsh environments.
summary: Myungsung Instrument Co., Ltd. develops and manufactures advanced pressure and temperature sensors tailored for the semiconductor industry. Their products are engineered for high accuracy and durability in challenging environments, particularly in chemical and slurry applications.

regional_presence.Korea: Myungsung Instrument has localized its operations in Korea, focusing on the semiconductor market since 1987.
